$comment: The only place model ids live. Everything else reads them from here (Terraform, the agent image, the web app for the labels). agentModel is the default model for clip jobs; clipModels lists, in display order, the models the owner may pick for clip jobs in Settings › Clip making › AI model (the clipModel setting, docs/CONTRACTS.md §5 and docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-42), each with a label and one plain line for that screen. A model's own profilePrefix overrides the top-level one (Haiku for Ask Clip Factory and Nova 2 Lite, the second watcher of the deep analysis, use the EU geo profile, docs/CONTRACTS.md §19.5 and docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-40); profileRegions lists that profile's destination regions, for IAM. embeddingModel.modelId is in-Region and used as is (never prefixed with profilePrefix). askModel and askFallbackModel are Ask's models (docs/CONTRACTS.md §28.1, ADR-51): Claude in Amazon Bedrock (the bedrock-mantle Messages API) in-Region at askEndpoint.region, so their bare modelId is used (no profile prefix); opus-4-8 is Ask's refusal fallback only and is not in clipModels.

opus-4-8.label: Claude Opus 4.8
opus-4-8.line: Ask's backup when Opus 5.5 says no.

pricing.$comment: The only place prices live (docs/CONTRACTS.md §51, ADR-103). US dollars per million tokens, as AWS publishes them for eu-north-1 on Amazon Bedrock (the AWS price list files; Anthropic's pricing page agrees on every global Claude price). A model called through the global profile gets the global price; one called through the eu profile (profilePrefix eu) gets AWS's regional price, 10 percent higher. cacheWritePerMTok is the 5-minute cache write. A line whose price could not be confirmed has confirmed:false and no numbers: the job shows its tokens and 'price not known' and the total as 'about', never an invented price. approximate:true means the price depends on the request (Haiku 5.5 costs more above 100,000 prompt tokens), so the line shows as 'about'. Change a price only from the provider's own page and move checkedOn.

haiku-5-5.source: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonBedrockFoundationModels/current/index.json (EU regional, prompts up to 100,000 tokens; above that 0.55 in and 2.75 out)

nova-2-lite.source: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonBedrock/current/index.json (EU regional; video is billed as ordinary input tokens, AWS lists no video line)

transcribe.source: https://aws.amazon.com/transcribe/pricing/ and https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/transcribe/current/index.json (eu-north-1, $0.0001 per second, one-second steps, speaker labels and language identification included)
